reflectionQuestion: Has anyone ever said something kind to you that made a hard day feel better?
title: The Brick Wall
theme: encouraging someone else, lifting up, kind words
reflectionText:
Marcus remembered how it felt to be new and alone. So when he saw Juliet sitting by herself, he walked over. He didn't do anything big or fancy. He just sat down and talked.

Sometimes the most encouraging thing we can do is simply show up for someone and say, "I know how that feels."
